titleZh: Andela推出激光与电击联合除草机器人，产能翻倍并实现全田覆盖
summaryZh: Andela发布第二代除草机器人，采用新型M-pede机械臂将行内间距从45厘米缩小至25厘米，实现全田覆盖，单臂除草速度从每秒3株提升至8株。机器人可同时搭载电击除草臂和激光除草模块，激光处理5毫米以下小杂草，电击应对大草，组合产能预计达每秒15株。新一代4.5米机型可匹配旧款9米机型产能，并计划下季实现全自主作业，旧机型有望改装升级。
featuredReason: 该报道展示了激光与电击联合除草的技术路线及模块化机械臂设计，对关注田间自动化除草、机器人产能提升和全自主作业的智慧农业从业者具有直接参考价值，尤其适合大田和有机农业场景。
contentFull:
Laser weeding and electrocution at the same time

 27-10 | Field robots | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Photo's: Lucas van de Weijer

Robot manufacturer and NPPL+R participant Andela is launching a new weeding robot. The robot can now provide full-field coverage and has twice the capacity of the previous machine, increasing from 3 to 8 weeds per second per weeding unit. Andela is introducing the laser weeder after a large organic farming customer gained experience using electrical and laser weed control simultaneously.

The robot achieves its doubled capacity through a double row of arms suspended within the frame. The 2 arms, which Andela calls M-pede arms, replace the previous Delta arms. The new arms still move along the same axes as their predecessors. Each arm moves along the X and Y axes and vertically along the Z axis. However, each arm now has only 1 connection to the frame. This single connection eliminates the need for an angled support to provide the required freedom of movement. Without the angled arm used on the previous Delta robots, the arms can now be positioned at a spacing of 25 cm rather than 45 cm. This allows the robot to provide full-field coverage. The design is also much more compact, allowing 2 arms to be positioned one behind the other and directly alongside neighbouring arms.

The exterior of the new Andela weeding robot has changed very little. This means it should be possible to equip the previous generation with the new arms in future. The more compact design of the new M-pede arms allows 2 weeding arms to be fitted to a single unit. This alone doubles capacity, while fewer arm movements to reach the weeds and an improved algorithm increase capacity further.No wider than 6 metres

The new generation of robotic weeders is available with 4, 6 or 8/9 weeding units. This translates into an in-row working width of 3 to 6 metres. For full-field weeding, the machine’s working width is narrower. The arms have a modular design, and additional weeding units can be mounted on a 4.5-metre machine. One of the robots is being developed for use on sports pitches and golf courses, with 10 weeding units fitted to the 2.5-metre version. Thanks to its increased capacity, a new 4.5-metre robot can match the capacity of the previous 9-metre robot.

Laser weeding and electrocution at the same time

In addition to the front arm delivering an electric shock, Andela has developed a laser weeder that operates behind the electrical arm. The laser targets small weeds, while the electrical arm tackles larger weeds or those far enough from the crop to prevent it from being affected by leakage current. The arm carrying the electrical probe can easily be removed and be replaced with a laser weeding module.

Andela has also written the entire algorithm and developed the hardware for this laser weeder in-house. Its laser weeding unit uses blue diode light. This is comparable to the technology used by other manufacturers and is both relatively inexpensive and energy-efficient. This combination makes it attractive to the manufacturer, as the robot runs on a combination of batteries and solar panels.

The exact capacity and performance of the laser weeding units are not yet known, as the unit was still under development when NPPL visited Andela. The manufacturer expects the combined laser and electrical weeding unit to handle 15 weeds per second.

The new M-pede arms no longer require a third connection to provide freedom of movement. This has reduced the spacing between the arms from 45 to 25 cm, allowing the robot to provide full-field coverage.Organic farming

Andela is introducing the laser weeder after a large organic farming customer gained experience using electrical and laser weed control simultaneously. The laser tackled all weeds up to 5 mm in size, while the Andela Robot Weeder handled the rest. According to Andela, a laser alone often lacks sufficient capacity, particularly when conditions favour weed growth, making the combined approach more effective.

Fully autonomous

From next season, the Andela Robot Weeder will also be able to operate fully autonomously. The robot could already navigate the field independently but still needed assistance to turn on the headland. From next season, all robots will be ready for fully autonomous operation. To enable this, Andela has updated the software and can now equip the robots with sensors for safe autonomous operation. Finally, Andela is exploring the possibility of fitting the new M-pede robotic arms to older robots. The frame has remained virtually unchanged between the previous and new generations, so retrofitting should be possible. However, Andela will only begin working on this next year and does not expect to bring it to market until 2028.

The exact price of the second-generation Andela Robot Weeders is not yet known. However, the manufacturer says pricing will be in line with that of the previous generation.

translationZh:
机器人制造商兼NPPL+R参与者Andela正在推出一款新型除草机器人。该机器人现在能够实现全田覆盖，产能是前代机器的两倍，每个除草单元从每秒3株杂草提升至每秒8株。Andela推出这款激光除草机，源于一位大型有机农业客户同时使用电击和激光除草控制的经验。

该机器人通过悬挂在框架内的双排机械臂实现产能翻倍。这两个机械臂被Andela称为M-pede臂，取代了此前的Delta臂。新机械臂仍沿与前辈相同的轴线运动。每个臂沿X轴和Y轴移动，并沿Z轴垂直移动。然而，每个臂现在与框架只有一个连接点。这种单连接设计消除了提供所需运动自由度所需的斜向支撑。没有了前代Delta机器人使用的斜向臂，机械臂间距现在可以做到25厘米而非45厘米。这使得机器人能够提供全田覆盖。设计也更加紧凑，允许两个臂一前一后放置，并直接紧邻相邻臂。

新款Andela除草机器人的外观变化很小。这意味着未来应该可以为上一代产品配备新机械臂。更紧凑的M-pede臂设计允许在单个单元上安装两个除草臂。仅此一项就使产能翻倍，而到达杂草所需的臂运动次数减少以及算法改进进一步提升了产能。

**宽度不超过6米**

新一代机器人除草机提供4、6或8/9个除草单元。这对应3至6米的行内工作宽度。对于全田除草，机器的工作宽度更窄。机械臂采用模块化设计，可以在4.5米机器上安装额外的除草单元。其中一台机器人正在开发用于运动草坪和高尔夫球场，在2.5米版本上安装10个除草单元。得益于产能提升，一台新的4.5米机器人可以匹配前代9米机器人的产能。

**激光除草与电击同时进行**

除了提供电击的前置机械臂外，Andela还开发了一款激光除草机，运行在电击臂后方。激光针对小杂草，而电击臂处理较大的杂草或距离作物足够远、可防止泄漏电流影响作物的杂草。携带电击探头的机械臂可以轻松拆卸，并替换为激光除草模块。

Andela还自主编写了整个算法并开发了这款激光除草机的硬件。其激光除草单元使用蓝色二极管光源。这与其他制造商使用的技术相当，且相对廉价且节能。这种组合对制造商具有吸引力，因为机器人依靠电池和太阳能电池板的组合运行。

激光除草单元的确切产能和性能尚不清楚，因为NPPL访问Andela时该单元仍在开发中。制造商预计激光与电击联合除草单元每秒可处理15株杂草。

新的M-pede臂不再需要第三个连接来提供运动自由度。这将臂间距从45厘米缩小至25厘米，使机器人能够提供全田覆盖。

**有机农业**

Andela推出激光除草机，源于一位大型有机农业客户同时使用电击和激光除草控制的经验。激光处理所有5毫米以下的杂草，而Andela机器人除草机处理其余的。据Andela称，激光单独使用往往产能不足，尤其是在有利于杂草生长的条件下，因此组合方法更为有效。

**完全自主**

从下个季节开始，Andela机器人除草机还将能够完全自主运行。该机器人已经可以独立在田间导航，但仍需要协助在地头转弯。从下个季节起，所有机器人将准备好完全自主运行。为实现这一点，Andela更新了软件，现在可以为机器人配备传感器以实现安全的自主运行。最后，Andela正在探索将新的M-pede机械臂安装到旧款机器人上的可能性。前代和新代之间的框架几乎保持不变，因此改装应该是可行的。然而，Andela要到明年才开始这项工作，预计2028年才能推向市场。

第二代Andela机器人除草机的确切价格尚不清楚。不过，制造商表示定价将与上一代保持一致。
author: Lucas van de Weijer
